designationHistory.name: Klamath Lake Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Klamath Lake Reservation in Oregon and California, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds on Lower Klamath Lake, by Executive Order 924.
designationHistory.note: Often called the first refuge for waterfowl; that superlative was not checked here. Renamed Lower Klamath National Wildlife Refuge (California and Oregon) by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940. The reservation was later reduced by EO 2200 (May 14, 1915) and other orders.
